args: Run /twin-weekly-impact on ~/antigravity-twin/memory/: summarize this week's completed [x] tasks and initiative progress across Altitude 1 (Executive Outcomes), Altitude 2 (Reusable Assets), and Altitude 3 (Workstream Velocity), save weekly/YYYY-WXX.md, and append to impact/ledger.json.
